checks.notes: Initial seeding entry for this release, not a live syllabus check. What was done: the curriculum corpus in this repository (including data/readiness-checklist.json and data/operational-rules.json added in this release) was transcribed from the operational syllabus source document version 2.0, dated 2026-09-04 (see syllabusVersion/syllabusDate above), and the five official sources listed in `sources` (R1 Silabus OSN Informatika 2026, R2 Silabus OSN-K Informatika 2026, R3 Silabus OSN-P Informatika 2026, R7 IOI official syllabus page, R8 IOI Syllabus 2025 PDF) are exactly the official OSN/IOI sources that source document itself cites. What was NOT done: no live check of these external websites was performed for this entry -- the tooling that produced this corpus has no network access, so this entry records transcription provenance only, not a verified-live confirmation that the upstream pages are unchanged since 2026-09-04. The next syllabus check, required before the next cohort cycle per §14.2 rule 8 and the Catatan Penutup, must perform the actual live check against these sources and record a fresh entry here, per docs/operations/syllabus-check.md.

Live syllabus check performed on 2026-11-18 by an AI agent (Claude) on behalf of the repository owner, per the owner's decision recorded on issue #95; it is not a human-performed check. Method: each page was fetched over the network with a web-fetch tool that returns a model-generated summary of the page (not raw HTML), so wording-level differences could not be ruled out; the R8 PDF was downloaded to an empty temporary directory and read as text only. R1 (https://osn.toki.id/silabus): reachable. Lists 10 rumpun materi (Dasar-dasar Pemrograman; Operasi Logika dan Bitwise; Aritmetika; Aturan Berhitung; Rekursi; Pencarian dan Pengurutan; Strategi Pemecahan Masalah; Struktur Data; Graf dan Tree; Geometri Dasar) -- the same ten families, in the same order and with the same sub-topics, as data/osn/topic-families.json (§2.1). Two wording-level observations, not changes: the page's 'Operasi Logika dan Bitwise' item lists no explicit bit operations (the corpus coverage lists 'operasi bit'), and the page does not name C++ (the corpus says 'C++ syntax/semantics'). The page carries no publication date and says it differs from the 2025 syllabus without listing the differences, so no diff against a prior snapshot was possible; the comparison is against the corpus only. R2 (https://osn.toki.id/silabus/kota): reachable. States no difference from the OSN-K 2025 syllabus; format 30-50 questions in 2.5 hours (parts A/B/C, no essay) -- matches contestFormat of osn-k in data/osn/competition-stages.json (30-50 items, 150 minutes). R3 (https://osn.toki.id/silabus/provinsi): reachable. States no difference from the OSN-P 2025 syllabus; format 5-8 case studies in 3 hours, each with 3 comprehension questions and 1 programming problem with an easy and a hard subtask -- matches contestFormat of osn-p (5-8 items, 180 minutes, 3 + 1 per case). The page does not list topics itself and refers to R1, so topic scope per stage was compared only through R1. R7 (https://ioinformatics.org/page/syllabus/12): reachable. States it is the official Syllabus for IOI 2025 and links /files/ioi-syllabus-2025.pdf; no newer syllabus version is announced there. R8 (https://ioinformatics.org/files/ioi-syllabus-2025.pdf): reachable (HTTP 200, application/pdf, about 299 KB, 864 text lines). Section 1 says it is the official syllabus version used for IOI 2025 (changes made February 2024, official since the end of IOI 2024); the page footers still read 'DRAFT Version 2025'. Only version and status were compared: the corpus transcribes no IOI topic list (only the generic 'toki-ioi-extension' stage), so there was no IOI topic-by-topic comparison and none was attempted. Not done: no comparison of OSN-N (national) specifics, no comparison against the Pedoman OSN 2026 linked from the pages, no check of sample-question pages, and the docs/silabus/ transcription was not diffed line by line (topic and format level only). Outcome is no-change at this comparison depth. The corpus, docs/silabus/ and the earlier entry in this file were not modified.
